definition_translations.zh_TW: 監督活動或組織的行為

senses.gloss: an accidental failure to notice or do something
senses.example: The missing signature was a minor administrative oversight.

translations.th_TH: ความผิดพลาดโดยไม่ได้ตั้งใจ

example_translations.zh_TW: 漏掉簽名只是輕微的行政疏失。
